scope: Two independent cold installations of the same immutable 6.372GB snapshot on shared2/1024MiB Fly EWR slots. Cache directory birth through archive unlink; excludes provider provisioning, source catch-up and restart qualification.
limitations: Different provider machines and times; not repeated controlled performance samples or a production SLO.
Manual rollout additionally replayed about eleven hours of source changes, unlike an ordinary fresh snapshot refresh.
Installation receipt installed_at is assigned before final fallback verification and directory promotion.
